name: MGB Random Number ActionTag
description: External module that adds an action-tag to this project for generating random numbers on text fields.

action-tags.description: Random number generates a random number between 2 values - defaults to 1 and 100.  Also can specify range MGB_RANDOMNUMBER(101,110).

project-settings.name:
Range options for default: 1 to 100 or 0 to 100
unchecked = 1 to 100,
checked = 0 to 100

versions.1.1.0: Feature: add unique number within a project. Code improvements and clean up.
versions.1.0.5: Minor update: standardize branding, emails and doc updates.
versions.1.0.4: Bug fix: fixes min and max values to be robust. Also fixes problem with leading paren making value be zero for MIN.
versions.1.0.3: Updated PHP8 fixes and other minor update changes.
